title: Thanks to generative AI, I was able to create one of my passion projects, “My Week With Mae”
author: SafijivaLoreMaster-
selftext:
And I’d like to share it with you all, if you’re interested. It is a psychological visual novel, with some twists. One of my goals was to push the Ren’py engine beyond what a traditional visual novel could do. 

Plot: You are invited by your best friend, Mae, to spend a week in her parent’s remote cabin, but everything may not be as it seems.

Use of AI is only for the majority of the artwork. The writing, music, and most of the sound effect were created by me(I sampled a few sound effects for comedic purposes).

Didn’t really know where else to share this project, but it’s been eight months in the making and I’m tired of seeing it collect dust. My main goal of the game is to just deliver a fun and unpredictable experience. Hope you all enjoy it, it’s free for windows and always will be. 

Also, warning for flashing lights and content that some might find disturbing.
